headline: First 14 turbines in Datang Zhongwei's Chang Le wind project connect and generate
summary: China Energy Engineering Corporation reports that on 2026-10-05 the first 14 turbines in the first section of Datang Zhongwei's Chang Le 500-MW wind project completed energization and grid connection and generated successfully. The builder says 75 turbines are planned for the segment and links it to the Zhongwei compute campus. This is a partial commissioning milestone; the report provides no interval generation or campus-delivery data.
